payload.text: LINUX AND BREW (hv, 2026-10-14): devbin and Intent work properly on Ubuntu, proven on kovacs, and install with brew on Linux and macOS (hv: "I want BOTH devbin and intent work from 'brew install' and for them to BOTH work seamlessly on Unix (the kovacs VM in this case)"). Restated by hv through another estate's session the same morning: through Homebrew on macOS and Linux, with nothing installed from a local repository, so the brew install becomes the machine install that projects vendor from; that estate waits on the first release that carries Linux binaries. Planned by devbin-vc and intent-vc with hv. kovacs-sysadm, a Remote Control session on kovacs, does the VM side on orders from either vc; there is one queue for kovacs, intent-vc's, with one order per step, each copied to the other vc. kovacs, read 2026-10-14: Ubuntu 26.04.1 on aarch64, 2 CPUs, 3.3 GiB, uutils coreutils 0.10.0, GNU parallel 20240222; GitHub auth works as hv; hv's home is readable there at ~/mac, so a bundle goes in vc's scratch. Order: provisioning; Intent's bin/int linux build, package and smoke from a bundle of its main; Intent's AT-05.1; a user-level drive of Intent; devbin's Linux proof with Intent's package on PATH (main's HEAD by bundle, test all read from its seal, check all with the critic gate); brew last, as hv rules. devbin has no formula or tap yet (0195 builds the formula) and its repo is private; Intent's formula is macOS arm64 only by hv's ruling of 2026-08-15, and Intent's ST0081, renumbered on 2026-10-14, is now its Homebrew thread for Linux and macOS (doing 81). STATE at the end-of-day fold of 2026-10-14: ORDER 1 (provisioning) is COMPLETE, as kovacs-sysadm reported. apt gave libxml2-utils, musl-tools, build-essential, xz-utils, curl and procps; the four download steps that kovacs-sysadm's permission classifier refused, hv ran by hand in ~/prov/provision-rest.sh, every one at rc 0: bats 1.12.0 at /usr/local/bin, first on PATH (CI's pin; apt's 1.13.0 is shadowed), shellcheck 0.11.0 at /usr/local/bin, Rust 1.99.0 with the aarch64 gnu and musl targets, and Homebrew 7.0.9 at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew, off PATH. Caveat: hv's zshrc puts ~/.cargo/bin on PATH in interactive zsh, hv's ! commands included. ORDER 2 (Intent's clone and doctor) found Intent's own silent exit 127 without rustc (Intent's issue 0595); devbin's dispatcher ran clean under uutils and mawk. devbin's ORDER D1 RAN. hv started it with ! at 10:13:40Z, and a ! command's 120 s timeout cut it off at 10:21Z, 571 tests in (kept on kovacs as aborted-1013-*). kovacs-sysadm reran it in the background on hv's ask, 10:24:24Z to 10:49:25Z, at 2ff34a98 (0193's code, and main's lib/ and tests/ today) under bats 1.12.0, uutils 0.10.0, mawk, shellcheck 0.11.0 and GNU parallel at 2 jobs: 2306 of 2307 ok, 1 not ok, 106 skipped, seal ~/work/devbin-vc/devbin-2ff34a98/tmp/test/20261014-1024 on kovacs, read by vc over ssh, read-only. The one failure, targetdir.bats:720, is devbin's own test: it says it needs no cargo, but cargo was off PATH (installed in ~/.cargo/bin, which only interactive zsh adds), so the probe's no-cargo verdict came first. The code stands, nothing points at uutils, mawk or aarch64, and the issue is drafted, to file at the next start (todo 158). The skips: 63 for cargo off PATH, 24 for expect, 1 for prettier, and the rest things this platform cannot show; the Mac skips 5. d1.sh ended on an echo, so it returned 0 over the failed suite (its log said exit 1 and was read right): every order script vc writes ends with the suite's own status, and detaches itself, since a ! command dies at 120 s. D1b, the same code with cargo on PATH and expect from apt, covering 87 of the skipped arms, is put to hv (todo 157). No vc routes around kovacs-sysadm's boundary, ssh included. STATE AT 2026-10-15 14:00Z: hv's go on the day's plan came in vc's session, and kovacs is free (kovacs-sysadm: Intent's orders 3b, 3, 5, 7b, 6a and 6b are done). D1b, devbin's full suite at 89cae16e (main's head, whose code outside intent/ is D1's 2ff34a98) with expect from apt and cargo on PATH, went to intent-vc's queue at 13:50Z: the script and its bundle are in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/kovacs/ (devbin-89cae16e.bundle, sha256 7ac66dfb...0ab). Its first launch, d1b.sh at 13:53:59Z on intent-vc's GO, stopped in setup at 13:54:03Z with exit 2, on vc's defect: `git bundle verify` needs a repository, and the worker ran in kovacs-sysadm's cwd, which is none; the Mac sandbox had launched from devbin's repository and hid it. Everything before it passed: the env scrub (12 inherited variables, CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_*, CLAUDE_EFFORT, CLAUDE_PID and GIT_EDITOR), expect 5.45.4 from apt (installed, and it stays), and cargo 1.99.0. Its d1b.log and d1b.rc stay on kovacs as that launch's record. d1b2.sh (sha256 443275fb...11d) works from its own directory and checks the bundle by its sha256 alone; driven on the Mac from a cwd in no repository, the first script failed there as on kovacs and d1b2.sh passed with the suite stubbed. Its GO went to kovacs-sysadm at 13:56Z, and vc reads its seal over ssh, read-only, at END. NEXT devbin order on kovacs, after D1b: check all with Intent's Linux package on PATH (ORDER 3's package exists), then 0195's brew proof there. This Mac: intent/cc's booking ended (intent-vc, about 13:54Z), and nothing of Intent's uses Homebrew here before 3.2.4's cut; devbin's full suite for 0195's landing books the Mac through intent-vc with START, a census and END.
